headers:
Bid Item 26-5 (HV DC cable, 250 LF): Drawing E201 calls for (2) parallel runs per
charger, each with (4) #1/0 Cu and (1) #4 Cu-G. Is the 250 LF quantity measured as
conduit-run footage or as total conductor footage?
sample:
The 250 LF quantity listed for Bid Item 26-5 represents the estimated total linear
footage of all conductors combined, rather than the conduit-run footage. The
actual quantity required may vary based on field conditions and the final
installation. Bidders shall review the Contract Documents and determine the
quantities of conductors, conduit, and associated materials necessary to complete
the installation in accordance with the project requirements. Any adjustments to
the final installed quantity or contract price shall be addressed in accordance with
the applicable provisions of the Contract Documents.
